qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Exclusive state-granted local gas distribution franchise network across Texas and 7 other states. Underground natural gas distribution pipes and Atmos Pipeline-Texas are physically unreplicable. Annual rate review mechanisms (Texas GRIP) provide formulaic pricing power to pass through capital costs and inflation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Balance sheet debt/NI = 7.4x > 4.0x, perpetual capex dilution, REJECT). Premier regulated natural gas LDC with excellent regulatory execution in Texas, but structurally bound by capped 6.0% ROIC, massive safety capex (4.8x D&A), and $8.9B debt requiring constant capital market issuance.
qualitative.evidence: 10-year median GAAP ROIC is 6.04% (tangible ROIC 6.3%), capped by regulatory cost-of-service ratemaking. TTM LT debt of $8.91B against net income of $1.20B yields 7.43x debt-to-earnings leverage, well above the 4.0x threshold. TTM capex of $3.56B dwarfs D&A ($735M) by 4.8x, generating structural cash deficits after growth/replacement capex that necessitate perpetual debt and equity market financing.
